speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Stable Angina (Non-ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction ruled out by normal troponins, with coronary arteries patent on CT angiography). Given the ischemic ECG changes but patent arteries, this may be vasospastic angina or microvascular angina. Do you have a history of Raynaud's phenomenon or does the pain improve with rest within minutes?
